description: Plan active-speaker camera switching for stacked, synced camera tracks: from speaker segments and a camera-to-speaker map it produces an angle cut list with minimum holds, crosstalk cover shots, optional lead-in cuts and periodic cutaways, plus razor times, per-camera enable/disable ranges, and markers. Local-only and deterministic; never changes Premiere.

cameras.description: Camera angles. A camera with one speaker is a single, two or more is a two_shot, none is a wide cover unless role says otherwise.

camera_id.description: Stable camera identifier such as 'A' or 'cam2'.

label.description: Display label used in marker names (default camera_id).

role.description: Override the inferred role: single, two_shot, or wide.

items.description: Speaker label framed by this camera.

video_track_index.description: Video track holding this camera's synced clip(s); used in enable_plan.

cover_on_overlap.description: Cut to a two_shot or wide camera when speakers overlap (default true).

cutaway_every_seconds.description: Insert a cover cutaway during monologues longer than this many seconds (default: none).

cutaway_seconds.description: Length of each cutaway (default 2.5; must be at least min_hold_seconds).

frame_rate.description: Sequence frame rate for snapping cut points; defaults to 30.

lead_switch_seconds.description: Cut to the incoming speaker this many seconds before they start, when the outgoing hold allows (default 0).

marker_color.description: Marker color index for the cut markers (default 6 = blue).

min_hold_seconds.description: Minimum time an angle stays on air; shorter changes are absorbed (default 2).

overlap_min_seconds.description: Minimum crosstalk length before the cover shot is used (default 0.6).

speaker_segments.description: Who is speaking when, in sequence seconds (from a transcript, diarization, or plan_speaker_checkerboard turns). Overlaps are allowed.

end_seconds.description: Segment end in sequence seconds (greater than start).

total_duration_seconds.description: Plan end in sequence seconds (default: last segment end).

name: plan_multicam_angle_switches

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Multicam Angle Switches
